div.div:
Lab 6 Task 2 findings:
• consecutive ids land on DIFFERENT shards — mapping looks random
• re-running gives IDENTICAL results — hashing is deterministic
• same value always → same shard (that's what makes routing computable)
• monotonic keys spread evenly — no write hotspot
